verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. The strategy has no text of its own: the President presented it in a speech on 29 March 2018, and the Government described it in press kits. Re-read the press kit 'Stratégie nationale de recherche en IA' of the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation and the Secretary of State for Digital Affairs of 28 November 2018 (enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr, stored 16 Oct 2026), which confirms the presentation of the strategy by the President on 29 March 2018 at the Collège de France, the Government's mobilisation around 'la stratégie AI for Humanity', the 1.5 billion euros, the three axes and the national research strategy; and the Élysée page with the text of the President's speech of 29 March 2018 (stored 17 Oct 2026), which gives the four pillars, the funding breakdown and the ethics measures. Stored again in this run: the Government's press kit 'Stratégie nationale pour l'intelligence artificielle – 2e phase' of 8 November 2021 (presse.economie.gouv.fr), which treats the 2018 strategy as the first phase (2018-2022), now ended, and launches the second phase. Press kits and speeches are announcements, so their quotes count as alt-official, and the record rests on them alone. elysee.fr is listed in pipeline/official-sites.json for G7 and INT but not for FR, so the speech's quotes count as secondary. 'AI for Humanity' is the strategy's own name; no English text of the strategy was found.

judgment.status_reasoning: The Government's press kit of 8 November 2021 (stored in this run) calls the 2018 strategy the national AI strategy for 2018-2022, says 'nous arrivons aujourd'hui au terme de la première phase de cette stratégie nationale pour l'IA' and launches a second phase. The strategy has been replaced by that second phase, so 'Superseded' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A national AI strategy whose main content is research, talent, data and funding, with ethics (transparency of algorithms, bias, certification, an IPCC-like body for AI) as one pillar; in scope with a scope_note.
judgment.date_reasoning: 29 March 2018, the day the President presented the strategy at the Collège de France (press kit page 5); there is no strategy document with a date of its own.
judgment.level_reasoning: The strategy exists only as the President's speech and the Government's press kits. The press kits of 2018 and 2021 are announcements on government domains (alt-official); the speech is an announcement on elysee.fr, which is not listed as official for FR (secondary). No instrument text exists to point official_url at (rule 7c), so title, date and status rest on alt-official evidence and the record falls to level B.
